name: Pemetrexed
mechanism: Folate analogue that, after polyglutamation, inhibits multiple folate-dependent enzymes in purine and pyrimidine synthesis. Greater activity in non-squamous NSCLC, attributed in part to lower thymidylate synthase expression than in squamous tumours, and established in pleural mesothelioma.
monitoring: Folic acid and vitamin B12 supplementation started before and continued during treatment
Corticosteroid premedication to reduce skin reactions
interactions: Renally excreted: avoid or use caution with NSAIDs in renal impairment; avoid in severe renal impairment. Drain significant effusions before therapy where possible.
resistance: Increased thymidylate synthase expression and reduced folylpolyglutamate synthetase activity.
